newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover fell to 260,100 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 594,670 denars at the previous session on Thursday as two companies traded, the exchange said.
A total of 153 Otex Ohrid shares traded on the third floor at 200 denars, up 50 from Thursday but still well below par of 1,941 denars.
Usie sold 170 stocks at 1,350 denars, up five from the previous close and also below par of 2,665 denars.
Traded volume was 381 shares on Thursday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
